purpose: Verify exact live provenance goal wording compiles and regressions pass.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python canonical/tests/test_goal_compiler.py
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve(); p=root/'canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gcprov5',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads((root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads((root/'canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_LIVE_PROVENANCE_AUDIT_001.json').read_text())['goal']
out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,root)
print(json.dumps({'status':'COMPILED','modes':[x['mode'] for x in out.get('compiled_parts',[])],'actions':[x.get('type') for x in out.get('controller_actions',[])]},sort_keys=True))
print('LIVE_PROVENANCE_EXACT_GOAL_COMPILED')
PY
